proposals.before: On the eve of resigning he sent a long letter to Grand Councilor Wang. It began: "The emperor's hunger for reform is keen and the empire's longing for order still keener, yet the machinery of government has barely moved. The reasons, I believe, are several.
proposals.after: On the eve of resigning he sent a long letter to the Grand Council prince-ministers. It began: "The emperor's hunger for reform is keen and the empire's longing for order still keener, yet the machinery of government has barely moved. The reasons, I believe, are several.
proposals.reason: 軍機王大臣 means the prince-minister(s) of the Grand Council (王大臣), not a person surnamed Wang.

proposals.before: About to request leave and return home, he submitted a letter to the Grand Council minister Wang stating his views, in summary as follows: "Today the Son of Heaven's desire for good government is urgent, and the empire's longing for good government is exceedingly pressing, yet the machinery of state has not turned—tracing the causes, there are several.
proposals.after: About to request leave and return home, he submitted a letter to the Grand Council prince-ministers stating his views, in summary as follows: "Today the Son of Heaven's desire for good government is urgent, and the empire's longing for good government is exceedingly pressing, yet the machinery of state has not turned—tracing the causes, there are several.
proposals.reason: 軍機王大臣 is an office designation for princely Grand Council ministers, not "minister Wang".

proposals.before: In the early Qianlong years the emperor labored from dawn to midnight in pursuit of perfect government. Men such as E Zhun, Zhu Shi, Zhang Tingyu, and Sun Jiagan spoke plainly and styled themselves seasoned mentors of the throne.
proposals.after: In the early Qianlong years the emperor labored from dawn to midnight in pursuit of perfect government. Men such as E Wenduan, Zhu Wenduan, Zhang Wenhe, and Sun Wending spoke plainly and styled themselves seasoned mentors of the throne.
proposals.reason: 鄂文端 is the posthumous name Wenduan (not "E Zhun"); the paired forms 硃文端、張文和、孫文定 should likewise keep the posthumous-name readings used in the Chinese.

proposals.before: Fortunately since Your Majesty took personal rule, Li Fenghan has died, Zheng Yuanhong has been impeached, Fu Gang has left office in mourning, and Jiang Lan has been transferred inland.
proposals.after: Fortunately since Your Majesty took personal rule, Li Fenghan has died, Zheng Yuanshuang has been impeached, Fu Gang has left office in mourning, and Jiang Lan has been transferred inland.
proposals.reason: The given name 鸘 is read shuang, not hong; idiomatic Zheng Yuanhong mistransliterates 鄭元鸘.

proposals.before: Fortunately since Your Majesty's personal rule, Li Fenghan has already died by himself, Zheng Yuanhong has already been impeached, Fu Gang has already suffered bereavement, Jiang Lan has already been transferred within.
proposals.after: Fortunately since Your Majesty's personal rule, Li Fenghan has already died by himself, Zheng Yuanshuang has already been impeached, Fu Gang has already suffered bereavement, Jiang Lan has already been transferred within.
proposals.reason: The given name 鸘 is read shuang, not hong; literal Zheng Yuanhong mistransliterates 鄭元鸘.

proposals.before: When I was in the inner court, a colleague told me: 'Of us ten princes, six or seven already keep vegetarian fasts and abstain from killing—sheep, pigs, geese, and ducks never enter our doors.'
proposals.after: When I was in the inner court, colleagues told me: 'Of us ten princes, six or seven already keep vegetarian fasts and abstain from killing—sheep, pigs, geese, and ducks never enter our doors.'
proposals.reason: Chinese 執事曾告之曰 is plural colleagues speaking as 某等; idiomatic singular a colleague understates the source.

proposals.before: Hubei and northern Huguang to Governor-General Bi Yuan and Grand Coordinator Wang Xin.
proposals.after: Northern Chu to Governor-General Bi Yuan and Grand Coordinator Wang Xin.
proposals.reason: 楚北 means northern Chu/Hubei; the idiomatic rendering invents an extra Huguang region not present in the Chinese.

proposals.before: The evidence is already exposed. Even if inner eunuchs lent their influence, these men's concealment and bungling are plainer still.
proposals.after: The evidence is already exposed. Even if inner court ministers lent their influence, these men's concealment and bungling are plainer still.
proposals.reason: 內臣 means inner-court ministers/officials, not specifically eunuchs; the idiomatic translation mistranslates the term.

proposals.before: Lady Qi of Wang, Yao Zhifu at Xiangyang, Tan Jiayao and Zhang Zhengmo at Changyang, and others took up arms on the news, and the revolt spread into Henan and Shaanxi.
proposals.after: Qi Wangshi (Wang, née Qi) and Yao Zhifu of Xiangyang, and Tan Jiayao, Zhang Zhengmo, and others of Changyang, took up arms on the news, and the revolt spread into Henan and Shaanxi.
proposals.reason: 齊王氏 is Wang of the Qi family (Wang, née Qi), not “Lady Qi of Wang”; the idiomatic phrasing reverses the name structure.

proposals.before: I ask that Grand Coordinator Le Bao be ordered to investigate strictly and report for punishment.
proposals.after: I ask that Military Commissioner Le Bao be ordered to investigate strictly and report for punishment.
proposals.reason: 經略 denotes a military commissioner, not Grand Coordinator (巡撫).

proposals.before: He should be ordered through Grand Coordinator Le Bao to investigate strictly and report for disposition.
proposals.after: He should be ordered through Military Commissioner Le Bao to investigate strictly and report for disposition.
proposals.reason: Same mistranslation of 經略 as Grand Coordinator in the literal English.

proposals.before: Moreover, an imperial grace decree now commands that all who accept pacification and return be ordered through Le Bao to summon Subprefect Liu Qing, together with Sichuan prefects and magistrates of long-standing clean reputation, to deliberate proper resettlement.
proposals.after: Moreover, an imperial grace decree now commands that, for all who accept pacification and return, Le Bao is to summon Subprefect Liu Qing together with Sichuan prefects and magistrates of long-standing clean reputation to deliberate proper resettlement.
proposals.reason: Literal English makes returning people the ones ordered to summon Liu Qing; Chinese has Le Bao summon Liu Qing to settle those who return.

proposals.before: Shen Kun argued that sheltering subordinates in Yixing had led to a great case in which many students were swept up and punished;
proposals.after: Shen Kun argued that Yixing sheltered subordinates, which led to a great case in which many students were implicated and punished;
proposals.reason: Parallel 論X lines name officials; 宜興 is likewise a personal name here, not the Jiangsu place-name.

proposals.before: Shen Kun argued that in Yixing, sheltering subordinates led to a great case in which many students were implicated and punished;
proposals.after: Shen Kun argued that Yixing sheltered subordinates, leading to a great case in which many students were implicated and punished;
proposals.reason: Same referent error: 宜興 is the official criticized, not a locative.

proposals.before: You Guangyi argued that great ministers had not yet achieved full harmony, that military preparations had not yet been fully rectified, and that he wished to emulate Wei Zhengyuan's Ten Reflections memorial to aid good government.
proposals.after: You Guangyi argued that great ministers had not yet achieved full harmony, that military preparations had not yet been fully rectified, and that he wished to emulate Wei Yuancheng's (Wei Zheng's) Ten Reflections memorial to aid good government.
proposals.reason: 魏元成 is Wei Zheng (魏徵), also known as 元成; 'Zhengyuan' is a mistransliteration.

proposals.before: When Gong Fu saw Songyun punished for opposing the eastern tour, he drafted a secret memorial, settled his affairs, and only then submitted it—and in the end was pardoned.
proposals.after: When Gong Tang saw Songyun punished for opposing the eastern tour, he drafted a secret memorial, settled his affairs, and only then submitted it—and in the end was pardoned.
proposals.reason: 龔鏜 corresponds to Gong Tang; English 'Gong Fu' does not match 鏜.

proposals.before: Moreover, when Gong Fu saw Songyun punished for remonstrating against the eastern tour, he submitted a secret memorial stating his views again, put his affairs in order for after his death, and only then presented it—ultimately receiving lenient pardon.
proposals.after: Moreover, when Gong Tang saw Songyun punished for remonstrating against the eastern tour, he submitted a secret memorial stating his views again, put his affairs in order for after his death, and only then presented it—ultimately receiving lenient pardon.
proposals.reason: Same name error: 鏜 is Tang, not Fu.

decisions.reason: s0017 has 上書軍機王大臣言事; 軍機王大臣 is the Grand Council prince-ministers (王大臣), not a councilor surnamed Wang. The replacement restores the office designation without inventing a person.
The same s0017 phrase 軍機王大臣 is an office title, not "minister Wang". The proposed literal correctly renders the princely Grand Council ministers.
s0025 lists 鄂文端、硃文端、張文和、孫文定—surname plus posthumous name. "E Zhun" is not supported by 鄂文端, and the paired forms should keep those posthumous readings rather than mix in an invented given name.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 鄂文端、硃文端、張文和、孫文定

decisions.reason: s0154 names 鄭元鸘; 鸘 is read shuang, so Zheng Yuanshuang is required and Zheng Yuanhong is a mistransliteration.
The literal field likewise mistransliterates 鄭元鸘 as Zheng Yuanhong; Zheng Yuanshuang matches the character 鸘.
s0117 執事曾告之曰 does not force a plural informant; a single colleague can report the princes' collective 某等 speech. Plural "colleagues" is optional style, not a required correction.
s0207 has only 楚北責之…; 楚北 is northern Chu. "Hubei and northern Huguang" invents a second region not in the Chinese.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 楚北責之總督畢沅、巡撫汪新

decisions.reason: s0219 雖由內臣聲勢 uses 內臣 for inner-court ministers/officials, not specifically eunuchs (太監/宦官). The proposed "inner court ministers" restores the term.

decisions.after: Qi Wangshi (Qi, née Wang) and Yao Zhifu of Xiangyang, and Tan Jiayao, Zhang Zhengmo, and others of Changyang, took up arms on the news, and the revolt spread into Henan and Shaanxi.
decisions.reason: s0235 襄陽之齊王氏、姚之富，長陽之覃加耀、張正謨等 needs both the place grouping and the married-name form 齊王氏 (Qi, née Wang). The proposal rightly rejects "Lady Qi of Wang" and fixes the Xiangyang/Changyang grouping, but its gloss "(Wang, née Qi)" reverses husband and maiden surnames.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 襄陽之齊王氏、姚之富，長陽之覃加耀、張正謨等

decisions.reason: s0243 應請飭經略勒保嚴察奏辦; 經略 is military commissioner, not Grand Coordinator (巡撫).
The literal likewise mistranslates 經略 as Grand Coordinator; Military Commissioner matches the office in s0243.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 應請飭經略勒保嚴察奏辦

decisions.reason: s0244 凡受撫來歸者，令勒保傳喚同知劉清… makes Le Bao the one ordered to summon Liu Qing to settle returnees. The old literal wrongly makes the returnees the agents who summon.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 凡受撫來歸者，令勒保傳喚同知劉清

decisions.reason: In the parallel censorial list (論疆臣…; 論硃珪…; 沈琨論宜興…), 宜興 is the official criticized for 庇護屬員, not the Jiangsu place-name used as a locative.
The literal "in Yixing" likewise misreads 宜興 as a place; the clause names the official Yixing as the one who sheltered subordinates.
s0306 魏元成十思疏 points to Wei Zheng under the name 元成 (Yuancheng). "Wei Zhengyuan" wrongly concatenates those characters; Wei Yuancheng (Wei Zheng) is correct.
s0308 names 龔鏜; 鏜 is Tang, so Gong Tang is required and Gong Fu is unsupported.
The literal field has the same error: 鏜 must be Tang, not Fu.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 又龔鏜當鬆筠因諫東巡獲罪

claimRetractions.reason: Accepted r0003 shows alternate "E Zhun" arose only from mistranslating 鄂文端; s0025 supports Wenduan (c0050/c0051), not a separate E Zhun alias.
Accepted r0015 shows "Wei Zhengyuan" was created only by misreading 元成 as Zhengyuan; s0306 supports Wei Zheng / Wei Yuancheng (c0405), not that concatenated alias.

claimRevisions.reason: Accepted r0004 restores the reading of 鸘 as shuang; the personal-name claim’s English must be Zheng Yuanshuang while keeping zh, pinyin, id, subject, predicate, certainty, and evidence.
Revised r0009 shows "Lady Qi of Wang" reversed the married-name structure of 齊王氏; the title claim’s English must be Qi Wangshi (Qi, née Wang) while keeping zh and other claim fields.
Accepted r0016 restores 鏜 as Tang; the personal-name claim’s English must be Gong Tang while keeping zh, pinyin, and other claim fields.
